description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to certificate proof verification in Chromium's QUIC implementation, including ProofVerifierChromium and associated details.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium
classes.description: Implementation-specific proof verification details including certificate verification result, pinning failure log, and flags for PKP bypass and fatal errors.

classes.name: ProofVerifyContextChromium
classes.description: Context information for proof verification, including verification flags and logging source.

classes.name: ProofVerifierChromium
classes.description: Implements the QUIC ProofVerifier interface, handling multiple simultaneous certificate proof verification requests with dependencies on various network security components.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the proof verify details.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium
methods.description: Constructor initializing the verifier with dependencies.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default proof verification context.

methods.name: OnJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification job.
